image_description: A close-up view of a polished steel breastplate (cuirass) featuring a high-gloss reflective surface. The armor has a central vertical ridge, curved side edges, and visible attachment points including leather straps with brass rivets on the upper left shoulder area and side lacing holes. The bottom edge features a fauld or waist band structure.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The large white reflection at the bottom center appears slightly 'smudged' or painterly rather than having the crisp optical distortion expected from a perfect cylindrical/conical reflection on steel. It lacks fine environmental detail.
The black strap protruding from the left mid-section seems to float slightly without a clear hole or rivet anchoring it firmly to the plate, suggesting a minor generation error in connectivity.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a breastplate/cuirass and not a generic shield or vase.
To verify the 3D curvature of the metal and ensure the reflections align with a coherent light source and geometry.

focus_areas: Reflection coherence on curved metal surfaces
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the physics of the reflections. In AI-generated metal, reflections often warp incorrectly or look like 'noise' rather than distorted environment maps. Check if the rivets have actual depth/shadows or if they are just painted circles.
